subject: Channel-ready evidence bundle for co-sell & marketplace validation
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@cloudchannel.io>, Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@amazon.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Channel-ready evidence bundle for co-sell & marketplace validation

Hi Carmen / Mark —

Per our call this morning, attaching the initial evidence bundle so your marketplace intake teams can start the validation pass. Summary of what’s included in the zipped payload (see attached index):

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf — full audit report + control narratives (redacted where required)
- Redwood_PenTest_Letter_Q4_2026.pdf — executive letter from external assessor, scope + findings (no raw exploit data)
- DPA_Redwood_v2-track-changes.docx — our proposed DPA with redlines for co-sell terms
- evidence-index.csv — CSV mapping artifacts to catalog checklist items (Marketplace ID column included)

Key asks:
1) Can the marketplace intake team confirm whether the attached pen-test letter satisfies the "independent assessment" requirement for co-sell eligibility, or do you require the full technical report under an NDA?
2) For DPA: please flag any enterprise-specific clauses that block listing — we can open a DocuSign redline if legal wants to sign off quickly.
3) Region mapping: Mark, for AWS EU regions we’ll need a separate artifact showing data residency; I placed a placeholder in Drive.

Operational notes: we intentionally redacted raw logs & exploit PoCs — we can provide them under a mutual NDA and with a scoped access window. Evidence index includes suggested HubSpot metadata tags and the recommended Marketplace checklist mapping (column G).

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (pdf, 2.8MB)], [Attachment: Redwood_PenTest_Letter_Q4_2026.pdf (pdf, 120KB)], [Attachment: DPA_Redwood_v2-track-changes.docx (docx, 45KB)], [Attachment: evidence-index.csv (csv, 4KB)]

Next steps: If you can confirm the intake owner and whether your team needs a DocuSign envelope or an NDA-first delivery model, we’ll route immediately.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

--

From: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@cloudchannel.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Channel-ready evidence bundle for co-sell & marketplace validation

Thanks Naomi — the package looks complete for an initial intake. Quick answers and asks: 

- Pen-test: the marketplace intake team accepts a high-level assessor letter for catalog visibility, but for co-sell qualification we generally require the full technical report under an NDA. We’ll open an intake ticket and attach a standard NDA template; once that’s signed we’ll ingest the full report.
- DPA: Greenleaf Legal prefers track-changes in Word (good) and typically flags two common clauses: subprocessor lists and breach notification windows. I’ve CC’d Mark to confirm AWS-specific clauses.
- DocuSign: yes, please prepare a DocuSign envelope for the DPA once you have the final redline. We can expedite signature via our procurement channel.

I assigned intake ticket CC-8897 to our marketplace specialist — they will confirm expected artifact naming and a validation ETA (usually 5–7 business days after receipt of the full pen-test).

Please also send the SOC2 supplemental evidence (control-level artifacts) as separate files rather than embedded in the PDF; our automation uses discrete files to tag controls. The evidence-index.csv helps, but discrete files speed the validation.

Carmen Ruiz
Partner Programs Lead | CloudChannel Solutions
carmen.ruiz@cloudchannel.io

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@cloudchannel.io>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Channel-ready evidence bundle for co-sell & marketplace validation

Hi Carmen — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few operational clarifications from our side: 

- We will produce the SOC2 supplemental artifacts as separate files and upload them to the Drive folder linked below. Expect a set of 12 PDFs (control narratives, sample logs, configuration snapshots).
- For the full pen-test: we have a scoped access model (time-limited link + NDA). If the marketplace requires the raw technical report in-file, we can provision under NDA and mark the HubSpot record as "sensitive evidence provided".
- DPA redlines: Kimberly, could you highlight the subprocessor section and proposed compromise language? We’ll prepare a DocuSign envelope for signature once Carmen confirms the procurement path.

Drive upload (working folder): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/marketplace/evidence/RDW-CC-2027-0415

Jonas Weber
Sr. Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

[On Sat, Apr 17, 2027 at 08:03 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com> wrote:]
> Naomi: pinging to confirm whether Carmen wants the DocuSign now or after we upload supplemental artifacts.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@cloudchannel.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Channel-ready evidence bundle for co-sell & marketplace validation

Hi all — quick update from legal/compliance: 

- I reviewed DPA_Redwood_v2-track-changes.docx and proposed two changes in the subprocessor appendix: (1) allow a monthly subprocessor disclosure cadence instead of a live registry, and (2) cap breach notification at 72 hours with a contractual remediation plan. Text is in track-changes; see attachment.
- For the pen-test: we prefer to provide the full technical report to marketplace teams only after the NDA is executed. Kimberly attached a short cover note that Greenleaf Legal can use to request the technical report from our assessor.
- DocuSign: we will prepare the envelope now but set conditional routing: procurement signature only after the NDA completes ingestion. That keeps the DPA timeline moving while protecting raw artifacts.

Attachments: [Attachment: DPA_Redwood_v2-track-changes.docx (docx, 47KB)], [Attachment: PenTest_CoverNote_For_Marketplace.docx (docx, 6KB)]

If Mark needs AWS-specific language, Vivek will coordinate with cloud compliance to add the region residency clause.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
